id.title: Pembanding teks · Tools SagalaIT
id.lead: Tempel dua teks dan lihat apa yang berubah: baris yang ditambah, dihapus, dan kata yang berbeda di dalam baris. Semua dihitung di browser ini; teks Anda tidak dikirim dan tidak disimpan.
id.copy_fail: Tidak bisa menyalin di browser ini
id.eq_empty: Kedua teks masih kosong. Tempel teks di kedua kotak.
id.eq_opts: Kedua teks sama setelah opsi abaikan diterapkan.
id.approx: Kedua teks sangat besar dan berbeda jauh, jadi sebagian baris dianggap berubah seluruhnya. Hasilnya benar tetapi mungkin tidak yang paling ringkas.
id.sample_a:
Daftar belanja akhir pekan
beras 5 kg
gula 1 kg
minyak goreng 2 liter
telur 1 kg
teh celup

Catatan: bayar tunai di kasir.
id.sample_b:
Daftar belanja akhir pekan
beras 10 kg
gula 1 kg
telur 1 kg
teh celup
kopi bubuk

Catatan: bayar dengan kartu di kasir.

en.title: Text diff · Tools SagalaIT
en.lead: Paste two texts and see what changed: lines added, lines removed, and the words that differ inside a line. Everything is computed in this browser; your text is not sent anywhere and is not saved.
en.eq_empty: Both texts are empty. Paste text into both boxes.
en.eq_opts: The two texts are the same once the ignore options are applied.
en.approx: Both texts are very large and very different, so some lines are treated as entirely changed. The result is correct but may not be the shortest possible.
en.sample_a:
Weekend shopping list
rice 5 kg
sugar 1 kg
cooking oil 2 liters
eggs 1 kg
tea bags

Note: pay cash at the counter.
en.sample_b:
Weekend shopping list
rice 10 kg
sugar 1 kg
eggs 1 kg
tea bags
ground coffee

Note: pay by card at the counter.
